Legal

Privacy Policy

Last updated: September 2026

This is a small promo site for River Drift. We don't track you and we don't collect anything about you. Here are the details.

What this site is

It's a static page about our game. You can't create an account here, and there are no forms or newsletters. We don't collect or store any personal data.

Cookies

We don't set any cookies. There are no analytics, ads or tracking scripts on this site.

We don't sell your data

We never sell or share personal data. We don't have any to sell in the first place.

Files loaded from other services

Some files on this page come from other companies. When your browser downloads them, those companies can see your IP address and basic browser info, like with any website.

  • Steam (Valve) hosts our screenshots and trailers. You can read Valve's privacy policy.
  • Google Fonts serves the fonts on this page. You can read Google's privacy policy.
  • cdnjs (Cloudflare) serves hls.js, a small script that plays our trailers. You can read Cloudflare's privacy policy.

Links to other sites

We link to places like Steam, GitHub, Discord and social media. Once you click through, their own privacy policies apply.

Questions?

Send us an email at theartofdanelo@gmail.com and we'll get back to you.
